hero.name: Douaa Kaddar
hero.description: Specialized in web development, process automation and application integration. Higher National Diploma in Web Application Development, with experience in Laravel, PHP, JavaScript, Angular, Docker and n8n.

about.label: About me
about.headline: Passionate about technology and automation.
about.p1: I'm a developer passionate about technology and automation. During my professional internship I have worked on web application development, building automated WhatsApp assistants and process automation using n8n.
about.p2: I enjoy learning new technologies and building solutions that help optimize work for companies and users.

learning.label: Currently learning
learning.p1: I'm building Citafy in my spare time — a SaaS appointment manager for independent physiotherapists. I started the project to learn Inertia.js: I'd been doing Laravel + Angular separately with a REST API in between, and I wanted to see if working without that layer would let me ship personal projects faster.
learning.p2: I learned by building, not from tutorials — starting with Laravel Breeze and reaching for the docs whenever I hit a wall. In five weeks I have an MVP with multi-tenant auth, a drag-and-drop calendar, scheduled reminders driven by an Observer, and a public portal for patients via signed URL.

projects.label: Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of what I've built.

citafy.title: Citafy
citafy.description: SaaS appointment manager with automatic WhatsApp reminders for independent physiotherapists. Multi-tenant by user, drag-and-drop calendar (FullCalendar), reminders scheduled 24h before via Observer + scheduler, and a signed-UUID public portal where patients can confirm or cancel without logging in.

lunacuentos.title: Luna Cuentos
lunacuentos.description: Native iOS and Android app for bedtime children stories + AI-personalized tales. Monorepo with Laravel backend (REST API + Sanctum) and React Native mobile app via Expo. In-app subscriptions through RevenueCat, COPPA/GDPR/Apple Kids compliance, ready to ship to App Store and Google Play.

nutriplan.title: NutriPlan
nutriplan.description: Full-stack nutrition planning app. Laravel API + Angular 21 with Material Design 3. Integrates Open Food Facts to search real foods, calculates daily macros with charts and generates automatic weekly meal plans.

greenbite.title: GreenBite
greenbite.description: Laravel application to manage healthy recipes with nutritional information (kcal, protein, carbs, fats), filters by category and difficulty, search and full CRUD. Blade views with Bootstrap 5.
